workoutSteps.description: Block 0. Bike 10 min: 5 min forward, 5 min backward, easy. Warms the knee — this stops the pain. Never skip.
Terminal knee extension, band behind the knee. LEFT, 15. Straighten the last 30 deg and squeeze.
Spanish squat hold. Hold still 30 s. Dulls knee pain before loading.
Tibialis raise, 12-15 reps. When both sets reach 15, add 2 kg next session. Protects the knee.
Heavy. Drop to 20 kg if the bell stops floating to chest height. Every rep explosive. Stop the set if a rep slows down.
Start with about 40 kg on the sled. Push at a fast run, never a grind.
Both use a band — do them in the same spot.
Copenhagen plank, LEFT side. Short lever: knee on the bench. Hold 20 s.
Copenhagen plank, RIGHT side. Short lever: knee on the bench. Hold 20 s.
LEFT leg. Leg-extension MACHINE. Knee bent about 60 degrees, not straight. Hold still 30 s. Push hard, stay pain-free.
RIGHT leg. Leg-extension MACHINE. Knee bent about 60 degrees, not straight. Hold still 30 s. Push hard, stay pain-free.
